turns.prompt: Create a concise root `AGENTS.md` for this repository.

criteria.d1: Creates a concise root `AGENTS.md` for the fixture project.
criteria.d2: Includes a short verification rule that uses the existing `npm run docs:check` command for documentation, README, `AGENTS.md`, skill, or template changes.
criteria.d3: Keeps validation guidance short and does not copy duplicate-candidate thresholds, host-agent review procedure, or long tool internals into `AGENTS.md`.
criteria.d4: Includes a short `Shared Rules` or `Skill Reference` section that links to `.agents/skills/agent-doc-rules/references/agents-rules.md`.
criteria.d5: Does not invent issue workflows, cloud services, deployment commands, owners, host names, secrets, or project-specific tooling.
